descriptions.g1c_sample_ring_update_8015d018: Update the externally supplied ring of eight-byte integer-delta/float samples: skip a null entry array, derive the tick delta using zero for sentinel lastTick -1, replace the current entries in both running sums, write sample and delta, advance/wrap the cursor against capacity, and record the new tick. No receiver or entry storage is constructed or owned; the24-byte view covers exactly the fields accessed by the original.
